name: pac-bench-annotations-200
description: A small curated set of 200 human annotations intended to evaluate model annotation quality, consistency, and agreement with human labels across PAC-bench tasks. It measures how well models produce accurate, well-formed annotations and align with human judgments.
evaluation_method: accuracy (with inter-annotator agreement / Cohen's kappa often reported)
reputation: A small, specialized Hugging Face dataset with limited but practical use for annotation-quality checks.
